_comment: Values marked CALIBRATE are placeholders: they must be measured on the real setup.

vision._comment: diff_mode: 'max' (largest per-channel difference) or 'gray'. Aspect depends on camera tilt (blob = top + front face).

grid._comment: CALIBRATE: robot-frame centre of CELL_0_0 and unit steps along rows/cols (metres).

robot._comment_angles: CALIBRATE: firmware_deg = offset + sign * degrees(q_ik). Order: base, shoulder, elbow, wrist_pitch.
robot._comment_offsets: shoulder/elbow/wrist_pitch fitted on 2026-11-11 to ruler measurements of the grasp point above the cubes' table (6 poses, rms 4.3 mm). The nominal 157.5 left the tip 2 cm short and 3-6 cm low.
robot._comment_grip: Measured on the real Braccio++: 200 = hand fully open (HOME, approach, release), 150 = grasp. Higher = more open. Do NOT use the firmware limits (120/230): the gripper servo stalls and stops responding.
robot._comment_grasp: grasp_below_center_m: the fingers close this much below the cube centre (more of the cube between them). Places are lowered by the same amount.
robot._comment_droop: CALIBRATE: how much lower than commanded the real grasp point ends up, as [reach_m, drop_m] pairs (reach = horizontal distance from the base axis). IK aims higher by the interpolated drop. Measured as in test_arm_positions.md, section 6. Empty = no correction.

calibration._comment_marker: Marker centre in the tip frame (z along the gripper, toward the fingers): measured 10 cm back from the grasp point. tip_heights_m: heights of the grasp point above the table for the calibration poses.

planner._comment: backend: fast-downward (pip install up-fast-downward) or ff. command is used only by ff: ["wsl", "./ff"] on Windows, the ff path elsewhere.

llm._comment: OpenRouter (OpenAI-compatible). The key is read from the env var named in api_key_env. For LM Studio: base_url http://localhost:1234/v1, api_key "lm-studio".
